song.title: I Got You I Feel Good

guitar.evidence: Jimmy Nolen, James Brown's guitarist who pioneered the 'chicken scratch' funk rhythm style, is documented as a Fender Telecaster/Mustang player; well known among funk historians though James Brown himself wasn't the guitarist.

tone.target: bright James Brown funk clean with tight percussive snap
tone.profile: bright James Brown funk clean with tight percussive snap
tone.summary: A punchy, dry signal chain utilizing light compression, a clean boost for attack, and a Fender-style amp/cab combination with minimal reverb to capture the sharp, rhythmic feel of James Brown's funk.

rig.name: James Brown - I Got You I Feel Good - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tighten the rhythm and eliminate unwanted noise during muted chords.
Provide light compression to enhance the percussive snap and sustain of funk chords.
Give the initial attack a slight lift and brightness for maximum percussive punch.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Green OD to keep the tone clean while adding transient emphasis.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and dry, avoiding heavy crunch or distortion.
blocks.gap: The funk style requires minimal drive; keeping this module bypassed is key.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a bright, clean Fender-style amp suitable for funk and rhythm playing.
Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound matching the clean US Deluxe amp.
Enhance the high-end sparkle and cut through the mix while maintaining clarity.
Avoid the wah effect as per the musical verdict and keep the tone direct.
blocks.gap: The funk style requires a straight signal path without filtering effects.

blocks.purpose: Avoid modulation effects (chorus) as specified in the musical verdict.
blocks.gap: The goal is a dry, percussive sound; chorus would muddy the attack.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space (small room) without washing out the tight rhythm.
blocks.gap: Using Room with low mix to achieve 'dry rhythm feel' while adding minimal ambience.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better funk clarity.

proposals.reason: Enhance the percussive snap and high-end definition needed for funk.
